create_beta_distribution: create a Beta distribution with alpha and beta shape parameters using distrax Beta class
sample_from_beta: sample random values from a Beta distribution using the sample method with a PRNG key
compute_log_prob_beta: compute the log probability of a value under a Beta distribution using log_prob method
calculate_beta_entropy: calculate the Shannon entropy of a Beta distribution using the entropy method
compute_kl_divergence_beta: compute the KL divergence between two Beta distributions using the registered _kl_divergence_beta_beta function
